title: stochastic-viral-dynamics: exact stochastic simulation of a two-strain within-host viral model
description: Code and results for a reproducible study of a two-strain within-host viral model with a CTL response, comparing exact stochastic simulation (Gillespie direct method, numba-compiled) with the deterministic ODE limit and with branching-process predictions: establishment from small inocula, stochastic failure of immune activation, and the emergence of drug resistance under therapy.
